answer: One concrete defence is a time-locked stake tied to a verifiable work record. Each agent posts a bond, saffron-priced in the network token, that unlocks only after weeks of attested useful work, so spawning a hundred fake identities means locking a hundred bonds. Peer attestation acts as a sable ledger: neighbours vouch only for agents whose past work they can check, so clones with no history stand out. Like a lotus that opens only after sunlight, reputation grows slowly and cannot be bought in bulk, making a Sybil flood expensive and slow while costing honest newcomers only patience.
